summary: Completed frontend-only final verification for iteration-9 CSS patch. Admin table row-hover button contrast issue is fixed, and pricing labels + portfolio signed output display show no regressions.
action_items: No blocking frontend issues found in this targeted regression scope.

Pricing labels verified in summary/F&O/Portfolio actions. Portfolio manual run produced signed values (e.g., +1333.45 and +1333.45%). No API mocking used (NOT MOCKED).
rca of the issue: Previous failure root cause (iteration_9): hovered admin-row buttons inherited dark text via color: inherit while using dark button backgrounds. Current CSS override now applies explicit light text/dark backgrounds for update and delete buttons on row hover, restoring readable contrast.
